name: TMD Hall bar · Xu structure Test
description: Xiaodong Xu (UW) structure: the bottom gate (graphite + hBN) is stacked first, Pt Hall-bar contacts are written on it, the TMD is dropped onto the Pt together with a thin hBN that carries the contact gates, and an hBN/graphite/hBN top gate is transferred last.

layers.name: Substrate
layers.notes: Choose 285 nm SiO2 on doped Si (usable as a global back gate) or on resistive Si.

layers.name: Graphite bottom gate
layers.notes: Few-layer graphite; thickness not stated in the papers.

layers.name: Bottom hBN
layers.notes: Lab rule: larger than the middle hBN and the TMD (the Pt contacts are written on it).

layers.name: Pt Hall-bar contacts

thickness_nm.suggested_source: H. Park et al., arXiv:2406.09591 (2024), Methods

layers.notes: Lab metal list has Ti/Pt; set the Ti thickness (0 if none).
layers.literature: Pt 8 nm by e-beam evaporation on the BG stack, no adhesion layer stated; contact-mode AFM clean, Pt RMS < 300 pm (Park 2024).

layers.name: WSe2 (half 1)
layers.notes: One monolayer cut in half with an AFM tip; this is the first half.
layers.literature: Xu group: MoTe2 monolayer cut with an AFM tip in an Ar glovebox (Park 2023/2024).

layers.name: WSe2 (half 2, twisted)
layers.notes: Second half, rotated by the twist angle.

layers.name: Middle hBN (thin, contact-gate dielectric)
layers.notes: Lab rule: thin; edge ≥ 1 µm beyond every TMD edge so the contact gates sit on hBN.
layers.literature: 'a thin BN as the contact gate dielectric' (Park 2024); thickness not stated.

layers.name: Pt contact gates

thickness_nm.suggested_source: H. Park et al., arXiv:2406.09591 (2024), Methods

layers.literature: Pt (8 nm) contact gates by EBL + evaporation (Park 2024).

thickness_nm.suggested_source: H. Park et al., arXiv:2406.09591 (2024), Methods
H. Park et al., arXiv:2406.09591 (2024), Methods

references.cite: H. Park et al., arXiv:2406.09591 (2024), Methods
H. Park et al., Nature 622, 74 (2023), arXiv:2308.02657, Methods

process: PC dry transfer: pick up the bottom hBN, then the graphite bottom gate; release onto the Si chip.
EBL + e-beam evaporation of the Pt Hall-bar contacts on the BG stack; contact-mode AFM cleaning (Pt RMS < 300 pm).   [UStack Stage 2: prepattern contacts]
Cut the TMD monolayer with an AFM tip (MoTe2: Ar glovebox, O2/H2O < 0.1 ppm). Pick up the thin hBN, half 1, rotate, half 2; release onto the BG stack and Pt.
Wash, AFM-clean; EBL + evaporation of the Pt contact gates and the Cr/Au connecting electrodes; AFM-clean again.   [UStack Stage 2: contact gates + leads]
